From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@crescenthealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration request — Crescent PO prerequisites

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. Crescent Health is moving to a new supplier portal and we need Redwood set up as a vendor so our AP team can route payments. Before we create a vendor record we need the following so the PO / invoice matching works cleanly: 

- Legal entity name, remit address and tax ID (W-9 or VAT registration as applicable)
- Preferred remit method (ACH / Wire / IBAN) and sample bank format (routing/IBAN + beneficiary name)
- Invoice file naming convention we expect (PO number visible in the filename)
- Primary billing contact email and phone number
- Any contract reference that must be printed on invoices for automated matching

Do you have an AP onboarding packet or a W-9 we can attach to the vendor record? We also need to know if you can accept PO quantity/unit matching (line-level matching) or only invoice total matching — that will determine our PO settings.

If you can upload into our portal, here’s the supplier registration link (portal requires a vendor ID request form): https://crescenthealth.vendorportal.com/suppliers/submit/AX-99234

If you prefer, reply with the info and attachments and I’ll create the vendor record manually. We’d like to have Redwood active before the May 1 payment cycle.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Specialist
Crescent Health Systems
ap-procurement@crescenthealth.com
+1 (415) 555-2248

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Attached are our AP enrollment packet and a current W-9. Quick answers inline below and next steps: 

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (doing business as Redwood Inference)
- Remit address: 1234 Innovation Drive, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax: W-9 attached (we are US entity). If you need EU VAT documentation for a local subsidiary let us know — that would require a separate entity record.
- Preferred remit method: ACH (domestic) by default. For international your portal may prefer wire/IBAN. Bank detail samples are included in the packet (see page 2).
- Invoice naming: Our suggested format is invoice_[PO#]_[InvoiceNumber]_[YYYYMMDD].pdf (we can adapt if your portal requires a different pattern)
- Billing contact: ap@redwood.com / +1 (628) 555-0199 (AP team); Accounts Receivable lead: Marissa Cole
- Contract reference: Please include the Contract ID: RWI-2027-Proc (we will mirror on our invoices)

Line-level matching: we can emit invoices with PO line references. Our billing system supports line-level details but if your portal enforces line-level exactness please share the PO schema so we can confirm.

Next steps: I’ve attached Redwood_AP_Enrollment_Packet_v1.pdf and Redwood_W9_2027.pdf. If you can create the vendor record using our documents, please reply with the vendor number/portal ID and any required field mappings (e.g., remit_email vs invoice_email). Otherwise we’ll register directly in your portal and paste the vendor request form.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks, packet received. A few clarifications from the Crescent AP intake team: 

- We created a provisional vendor record: Vendor ID CH-47521. Please use this for any future portal uploads.
- Our PO number you’ll see on POs is required to appear in the invoice filename and the first invoice line must include the PO number for automated matching.
- We strongly prefer receiving the banking details via the portal’s secure bank form rather than email — the portal link is returned when you submit the vendor registration. If you’d rather we can accept a signed ACH authorization PDF; our legal team requires a bank confirmation before wiring.
- Tax: W-9 is fine for the US entity. For cross-border work (we have EU subsidiaries) we may request VAT certificates — we’ll request those only if we create a second vendor record for a non-US entity.

Two items to note about payment timing and early-pay options: 
- Standard net-45 for vendor payments; early-pay (2/10 net-30) is available if you sign our early payment agreement — we can attach that to the vendor record.
- For May 1 availability, we need the portal-verified bank details and the first invoice uploaded with matching PO and contract reference by April 25 to make the cut for the May cycle.

Portal helpers: https://crescenthealth.vendorportal.com/supplier-help (see "Banking and Tax Documents").

Elena
